faqs.question: What doctors do you have?
faqs.answer: We have specialists in general medicine, dermatology, dentistry, pediatrics and physiotherapy.

faqs.question: Do you accept walk-ins?
faqs.answer: Yes, walk-ins are accepted subject to doctor availability.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can cancel your appointment. Cancellations less than 2 hours before the appointment may be subject to a charge.

faqs.question: Can I reschedule?
faqs.answer: Yes. I can help you find another available date and time.
